message.content: {"question":"How much heat Q is required to turn a block of ice with a mass of m = 50 g at a temperature of T₁ = -30 °C into water at T_w = 20 °C? The latent heat of fusion L = 80 cal/g and the specific heat of ice is c₁ = 0.5 cal/g and for water c_w = 1 cal/g","options":{"A":"Q = 5750 cal","B":"Q = 575 cal","C":"Q = 6 cal","D":"Q = 58 cal"},"correct":"A"}
